findings.title: Collides with Al Noor Hospitality Group: GCC hospitality data analytics non-compete
findings.impact: Collides with the Al Noor exclusivity commitment, which is active until September 2029 and covers all AtliQ Affiliates for GCC-based hospitality AI and analytics.

citations.quote: Itinerary Personalization Engine** — a recommendation service that generates personalised day-by-day itineraries using user preferences, trip purpose, budget, travel dates, past bookings and in-app behaviour, and re-ranks suggested activities, restaurants and experiences in real time

Partner Hotel Ranking Module** — a ranking and recommendation service that scores, ranks and surfaces Partner Hotels in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to TravelHub users at the point of search and itinerary building
Partner Performance Dashboard** — a dashboard for TravelHub's partnerships team showing impressions, click-through, bookings and commission by Partner Hotel, city and ranking position

In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC

Hospitality Business**" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity
Restricted Period**" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement

GCC**" means the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman

findings.counterPosition: Delay the commencement of GCC-based AI and analytics services for hotel distribution until the expiry of the Al Noor restricted period in September 2029, or seek a specific waiver from Al Noor.

waiver.covers: AtliQ providing demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat, Oman, solely as described in the statement of work between the Supplier and Seaside dated February 2026
waiver.why: The Al Noor waiver letter dated 10 February 2026 is strictly limited to services for Seaside Hotels LLC in Oman and explicitly excludes any other Hospitality Business in the GCC.

findings.impact: Names AtliQ Inc, but the client is in UAE: AtliQ Inc serves US clients only, so this should be AtliQ Pvt Ltd. The entity decides who invoices, the tax regime and the bank account; a mismatch caused two payment delays in 2025.

findings.title: Data protection terms without executed DPA
findings.impact: AtliQ risks processing user personal data without a fully compliant, dedicated data processing agreement in place.

citations.quote: AtliQ shall process personal data only on TravelHub's documented instructions and in compliance with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data and, where applicable, the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law

findings.standard: DPA (EU) or BAA (US health) signed before any personal/regulated data moves, with a sub-DPA / sub-BAA for every party that touches the data (incl. AtliQ's own Pune entity); engagement-specific scope; offshore access only as the agreement allows.
findings.counterPosition: Require the execution of AtliQ's standard Data Protection Agreement (DPA) before any personal data is transferred or processed under this agreement.

findings.title: One-sided convenience termination notice
findings.impact: AtliQ cannot terminate this agreement for convenience if the commercial relationship becomes unviable.

citations.quote: TravelHub may terminate for convenience with thirty (30) days' written notice and shall pay for all work performed up to the termination date

findings.standard: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
findings.counterPosition: Make the convenience termination right mutual with thirty (30) days' written notice for either party, ensuring AtliQ is paid for all work performed up to the termination date, including work in progress and committed costs.

findings.title: Payment terms trigger from invoice date rather than receipt
findings.impact: Any delay in the transmission or receipt of the invoice will shorten AtliQ's actual payment cycle.

citations.quote: TravelHub shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date by wire transfer to the bank account specified on the invoice

findings.standard: Invoices payable within 30 days of receipt; 45 days is the negotiated maximum.
findings.counterPosition: Amend the payment trigger to state that payments are due within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice.

precedents.note: AtliQ's own paper: 60-day payment changed to 30 for a 6-person agency (Oct 2025)

fine: Liability capped: Each Party's total liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
No liquidated damages or delay penalties are specified in this agreement, which is highly favorable.
The liability limit is mutual, capped at 1x fees paid in the preceding 12 months, and contains standard mutual carve-outs.
Indemnification obligations are limited and AtliQ's IP indemnity remains subject to the general liability cap, which is favorable.
IP ownership of custom deliverables transfers to the client only upon full payment, and AtliQ retains ownership of its background technology.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual, balanced, and have a standard three-year survival period.
The non-solicitation clause is mutual and limited to twelve months post-termination, which is acceptable.
No insurance requirements or minimum coverage limits are imposed on AtliQ in this draft.
The review period is ten business days with an automatic deemed acceptance mechanism, which matches standard requirements.
Standard warranty of professional services and a reasonable sixty-day conformity period are provided.
